name: brewfather-mcp
description: Remote MCP server for Brewfather: recipes, inventory, batches, and hydrometer readings

BREWFATHER_USER_ID.description: Your Brewfather **User Id**. Find it in Brewfather under **Settings → Integration**, API section.

BREWFATHER_API_KEY.description: Your Brewfather **API key** (same screen). Give it `recipes.read`, `recipes.write`, `inventory.read`, `batches.read`, and `batches.write`. Leave the delete scopes off.

ACCESS_PASSPHRASE.description: A long passphrase you make up. You enter it once when you connect your MCP client. Save it in your password manager.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores sign-in tokens. Created for you.
